# ramka

> Unstyled, accessible lightbox primitives for React — in the style of Radix UI and Base UI.

Generated from the HTML docs sources. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm docs:llms`.

Compose a fullscreen media lightbox from headless parts: view-transition morph by default, swipe slides, zoom, and pull-to-dismiss. You own colors and chrome; ramka owns state, focus, gestures, and structural styles those mechanics need.

## Docs

- [Installation](docs.md): Install ramka and a minimal Root + Slides setup.

## Lightbox

- [Overview](docs/lightbox.md): Accessible primitives for fullscreen media lightboxes — compound parts in the style of Base UI and Radix. Cosmetically unstyled: you own colors, chrome, and radius values. Ramka owns state, focus, gestures, morphs, and structural styles required for those mechanics.
- [State & lifecycle](docs/lightbox/state-lifecycle.md): Control open state and the active index from React, `createHandle()`, or both — and know when callbacks fire. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md).
- [Composition](docs/lightbox/composition.md): Default to Slides + Zoom (swipe carousel with pinch zoom), size media to fill Content, then layer chrome. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md).
- [Next.js Image](docs/lightbox/nextjs-image.md): Use `next/image` with Ramka. Lightbox-side blur depends on whether that item has a trigger image. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md).
- [View transitions](docs/lightbox/view-transitions.md): Morph open/close between a trigger and the active item with the browser View Transitions API. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md). Unsupported browsers, reduced-motion, and low-end devices fall back to a plain fade.
- [Gestures](docs/lightbox/gestures.md): Pull-to-dismiss, zoom/pan, and keyboard ownership. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md). For the usual gallery chrome (pull, zoom, keyboard) see the [Default preset](presets/default.md).
- [Zoom & a11y](docs/lightbox/zoom.md): How ramka’s zoom & pan — on desktop and on touch — lines up with mainstream image viewers, and how it maps to WCAG 2.2. For the wiring and gesture ownership, see [Gestures](docs/lightbox/gestures.md).
- [RTL support](docs/lightbox/rtl.md): Run the lightbox in a right-to-left reading direction — Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md).
- [Content Security Policy](docs/lightbox/csp.md): Running the lightbox on pages with a strict `style-src`. Part of [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md).
- [API reference](docs/lightbox/api.md): Props, data attributes, and CSS variables for every [Lightbox](docs/lightbox.md) part. Tables are generated from package TypeScript + JSDoc.

## Presets

- [Default](presets/default.md): Docs-demo chrome as a copy-paste design-system Lightbox
- [Twitter](presets/twitter.md): Split media + thread sidebar with translucent backdrop and edge nav
- [Store](presets/store.md): Commerce viewer: thumbnail rail + buy panel with price, highlights, and CTA
- [Editorial](presets/editorial.md): Newsroom article-figure viewer: near-black surface, caption + credit block
- [Stories](presets/stories.md): Avatar tray that crossfades into 9:16 video with a scroll-driven 3D page-turn

## Examples

- [Photos app](examples/lightbox/photos-app.md): macOS Photos–style square grid under a sticky, blurred toolbar with a fade gradient and "Library" title.
- [Photos app (RTL)](examples/lightbox/photos-app-rtl.md): The same photos app mirrored for a right-to-left locale — dir="rtl" on Lightbox.Root mirrors navigation, the thumbnail strip, and the arrow keys.
- [Infinite scroll](examples/lightbox/infinite-scroll.md): An endless feed where the lightbox paginates too — one photo array drives grid tiles and slides; the grid loads pages via an IntersectionObserver sentinel, and onValueChange fetches ahead inside the open viewer. The viewer is Lightbox.VirtualSlides: only a window of slides around the active index is mounted, so the native scroll-snap track stays cheap however long the feed grows, with a minimal Previous/Next chrome (no thumbnails).
- [URL-synced state](examples/lightbox/url-synced-state.md): Masonry wall wired to Next.js dynamic routes ([[...id]]) — every photo is a shareable URL: deep links open the viewer on that slide, swiping rewrites the URL in place, and browser Back closes the viewer.
- [Intercepted routes](examples/lightbox/intercepted-routes.md): The nextgram pattern: grid of plain Links, a @modal parallel-route slot, and an (.)photos/[id] intercepting route mounting an already-open controlled lightbox — Back closes it, hard loads get a standalone photo page (one URL, two presentations).
- [Text message](examples/lightbox/text-message.md): iMessage-style chat with a single morphTo="origin" trigger over a stack of attachments.
- [Film trailers](examples/lightbox/film-trailers.md): Movie posters morph into a fullscreen <video> that auto-plays on becoming active.
- [3D models](examples/lightbox/3d-models.md): Three.js product grid with Lightbox.Slides — onBeforeOpen preheats GLBs before the morph; shared orbit with each trigger.
